label: lem:bond-order-eq-jet-degree
title: Body order equals jet degree: the n-nucleon cluster sits at jet vertical degree n
html:
Let \mathcal{B}_K be the canonical atomic braid of a nucleus with A nucleons — each nucleon a 3-strand block, assembled by atom_braid_word_3A — and equip H_{3A}(q) with the Gröbner--Shirshov filtration by Coxeter length \ell(w) (prop:gb-spectral-sequence) read off through the jet-prefix order (prop:jet-prefix-gb-filtration). Then the body-order decomposition of the binding coincides, term by term, with the jet-order filtration,

\sum_{n} (\text{\(n\)-body term}) \;=\; \sum_{n}\mathrm{gr}_n ,

where:

  1. the sub-braid spanning an n-nucleon cluster lies in jet vertical degree n — its Gröbner--Shirshov normal form has filtration degree n; and
  2. the associated-graded component \mathrm{gr}_n of the filtration is exactly the n-body cluster contribution.

The obligation-(C) identification, the exhaustiveness of the cluster decomposition, and the physical framing are collected in the bond-order context.

Archimedean specialisation. What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall: it invokes real- or complex-analytic constructs — real-valued physical observables, real-analytic bounds, transcendental constants, or numerical evaluation at the substrate parameter q_0. Any generic categorical / q-deformation identities it draws on remain valid over an abstract coefficient ring; only their archimedean realisation is specialised here.
